title: A Statistical Imaging Framework for Inverse Obstacle Scattering and Its Resolution Analysis
summary: We develop a general statistical framework for inverse obstacle imaging and resolution analysis from far-field second moments under random illumination. The regularized $Q$-statistic is introduced and utilized to measure the minimal statistically weighted cost of synthesizing the test far field associated with a sampling point. Its reciprocal provides an imaging indicator. Under uniform full-aperture plane-wave illumination, we relate this indicator to several classical sampling indicators and derive their statistical counterparts for general random illumination.
